8th Grade · Unit 4 · On the Phone

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece wanted to visit the dentist yesterday. She called the clinic and chose ten o'clock on Friday. The clinic normally gives each visitor a fixed time. Ece made an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) appointment

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece wanted to visit the dentist yesterday. She called the clinic and chose ten o'clock on Friday. The clinic normally gives each visitor a fixed time.” Bu tarif “appointment” kelimesine uyar; appointment = randevu. Diğer şıklar: secretary (sekreter), communication (iletişim), message (mesaj).

2

Mert's phone had almost no battery power last night. He connected it to its power cable. He usually does this before bed. He needed to ______ his phone.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) charge

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert's phone had almost no battery power last night. He connected it to its power cable. He usually does this before bed.” Bu tarif “charge” kelimesine uyar; charge = şarj etmek. Diğer şıklar: call back (geri aramak), arrange (ayarlamak, düzenlemek), ring (telefon çalmak).

3

Selin knew her aunt's number yesterday. She pressed the correct digits before starting the call. She usually saves numbers, but this one was new. She needed to ______ the number.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) dial

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin knew her aunt's number yesterday. She pressed the correct digits before starting the call. She usually saves numbers, but this one was new.” Bu tarif “dial” kelimesine uyar; dial = numara çevirmek, tuşlamak. Diğer şıklar: put someone through (telefonda birine bağlamak), send an e-mail (e-posta göndermek), leave a message (mesaj bırakmak).

4

Bora heard his phone yesterday and answered it immediately. He did not let the caller wait. He usually tries to ______ quickly.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) answer the phone

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora heard his phone yesterday and answered it immediately. He did not let the caller wait.” Bu tarif “answer the phone” kelimesine uyar; answer the phone = telefona cevap vermek. Diğer şıklar: connect (bağlamak, bağlanmak), write a letter (mektup yazmak), have a live chat (canlı, görüntülü sohbet etmek).

5

Duru finished speaking to her cousin last night. She said goodbye and ended the call. She always ends calls politely. She needed to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) hang up

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru finished speaking to her cousin last night. She said goodbye and ended the call. She always ends calls politely.” Bu tarif “hang up” kelimesine uyar; hang up = telefonu kapatmak. Diğer şıklar: pick up (telefonu açmak, kaldırmak), keep in touch (iletişimde kalmak), speak to (biriyle konuşmak).

6

Arda called his brother yesterday, but his brother was in a lesson. Later, his brother returned the call. People often return calls when they become free. His brother chose to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) call back

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda called his brother yesterday, but his brother was in a lesson. Later, his brother returned the call. People often return calls when they become free.” Bu tarif “call back” kelimesine uyar; call back = geri aramak. Diğer şıklar: text (mesaj atmak, yazmak), make a phone call (telefon etmek), hang on (hatta beklemek).

7

Elif called a shop yesterday. Nobody answered, so she recorded her name and number after the greeting. Customers use this service when staff cannot answer. Elif decided to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) leave a message

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif called a shop yesterday. Nobody answered, so she recorded her name and number after the greeting. Customers use this service when staff cannot answer.” Bu tarif “leave a message” kelimesine uyar; leave a message = mesaj bırakmak. Diğer şıklar: contact (iletişim kurmak, ulaşmak), hold (hatta beklemek, tutmak), get back (arayana geri dönmek).

8

Can answered a call for his mother yesterday. His mother was not at home, so he wrote down the caller's name and reason for calling. He wanted to ______ for her.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) take a message

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can answered a call for his mother yesterday. His mother was not at home, so he wrote down the caller's name and reason for calling.” Bu tarif “take a message” kelimesine uyar; take a message = başkası için mesaj almak. Diğer şıklar: communicate (iletişim kurmak), repeat (tekrar etmek), dial (numara çevirmek, tuşlamak).

9

Nehir needed to speak to the head teacher yesterday. The person at the school desk answered calls and managed the head teacher's schedule. This person was the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) secretary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir needed to speak to the head teacher yesterday. The person at the school desk answered calls and managed the head teacher's schedule.” Bu tarif “secretary” kelimesine uyar; secretary = sekreter. Diğer şıklar: memo (kısa not, hatırlatma notu), caller (arayan kişi), smartphone (akıllı telefon).

10

Emir called the hospital's main number yesterday. Staff asked which department he wanted, and he gave the internal number 204. That internal number is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) extension

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir called the hospital's main number yesterday. Staff asked which department he wanted, and he gave the internal number 204.” Bu tarif “extension” kelimesine uyar; extension = dahili hat (numarası). Diğer şıklar: invention (icat, buluş), letter (mektup), mobile phone (cep telefonu).

11

Sena's grandmother moved to another city last year. They talk every weekend and send messages during the week. Their regular contact helps them ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) keep in touch

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena's grandmother moved to another city last year. They talk every weekend and send messages during the week.” Bu tarif “keep in touch” kelimesine uyar; keep in touch = iletişimde kalmak. Diğer şıklar: pick up (telefonu açmak, kaldırmak), text (mesaj atmak, yazmak), take a message (başkası için mesaj almak).

12

Baran received a call from an unknown number yesterday. The person who started the call introduced himself as Ali. The person making a call is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) caller

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran received a call from an unknown number yesterday. The person who started the call introduced himself as Ali.” Bu tarif “caller” kelimesine uyar; caller = arayan kişi. Diğer şıklar: telegram (telgraf), text message (kısa mesaj), receiver (aranan kişi; ahize).

13

İpek could not hear the last few words during a call yesterday. She asked the other person to say those words again. She wanted the speaker to ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) repeat

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek could not hear the last few words during a call yesterday. She asked the other person to say those words again.” Bu tarif “repeat” kelimesine uyar; repeat = tekrar etmek. Diğer şıklar: arrange (ayarlamak, düzenlemek), connect (bağlamak, bağlanmak), write a letter (mektup yazmak).

14

Tolga needed help with a delivery yesterday. He called a department where several staff members answer customer calls. This department is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) call center

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga needed help with a delivery yesterday. He called a department where several staff members answer customer calls.” Bu tarif “call center” kelimesine uyar; call center = çağrı merkezi. Diğer şıklar: line (telefon hattı), receiver (aranan kişi; ahize), extension (dahili hat (numarası)).

15

Eylül's uncle could not talk yesterday because he had another task to finish. He asked her to call later. He is often occupied in the afternoon. Yesterday, he was ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) busy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül's uncle could not talk yesterday because he had another task to finish. He asked her to call later. He is often occupied in the afternoon.” Bu tarif “busy” kelimesine uyar; busy = meşgul. Diğer şıklar: face-to-face (yüz yüze), get back (arayana geri dönmek), communication (iletişim).

16

Ozan checked his sister's schedule yesterday. She had no lesson or other task, so she agreed to talk. Someone who is free to speak is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) available

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan checked his sister's schedule yesterday. She had no lesson or other task, so she agreed to talk.” Bu tarif “available” kelimesine uyar; available = müsait, uygun. Diğer şıklar: engaged (meşgul (telefon hattı)), hang up (telefonu kapatmak), answer the phone (telefona cevap vermek).

17

Cemre asked for help on the phone yesterday. She said please, thanked the person and did not interrupt. She usually speaks respectfully. She was ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) polite

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre asked for help on the phone yesterday. She said please, thanked the person and did not interrupt. She usually speaks respectfully.” Bu tarif “polite” kelimesine uyar; polite = kibar, nazik. Diğer şıklar: make a phone call (telefon etmek), charge (şarj etmek), call center (çağrı merkezi).

18

Yusuf spoke to his friend in the same room yesterday. They did not use phones, messages or video. Their conversation took place ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) face-to-face

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf spoke to his friend in the same room yesterday. They did not use phones, messages or video.” Bu tarif “face-to-face” kelimesine uyar; face-to-face = yüz yüze. Diğer şıklar: politely (kibarca), online (çevrim içi), later (daha sonra).

19

Melis wrote a note to remind her father about a call yesterday. It was short and contained only the important details. A short reminder note is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) memo

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis wrote a note to remind her father about a call yesterday. It was short and contained only the important details.” Bu tarif “memo” kelimesine uyar; memo = kısa not, hatırlatma notu. Diğer şıklar: message (mesaj), text message (kısa mesaj), appointment (randevu).

20

Aras travelled with a small telephone in his pocket yesterday. He used it away from home without a cord. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) mobile phone

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras travelled with a small telephone in his pocket yesterday. He used it away from home without a cord.” Bu tarif “mobile phone” kelimesine uyar; mobile phone = cep telefonu. Diğer şıklar: line (telefon hattı), invention (icat, buluş), letter (mektup).

21

Sıla used her phone to open a map, browse a website and check an application yesterday. The phone does more than make calls. This kind of phone is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) smartphone

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla used her phone to open a map, browse a website and check an application yesterday. The phone does more than make calls.” Bu tarif “smartphone” kelimesine uyar; smartphone = akıllı telefon. Diğer şıklar: telegram (telgraf), message (mesaj), communication (iletişim).

22

Gökçe sent a short written note to her friend by phone last night. She did not speak or send a picture. The note was a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) text message

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe sent a short written note to her friend by phone last night. She did not speak or send a picture.” Bu tarif “text message” kelimesine uyar; text message = kısa mesaj. Diğer şıklar: caller (arayan kişi), letter (mektup), mobile phone (cep telefonu).

23

Defne needed help from her teacher yesterday. She wrote to ask for advice. When you reach a person to ask or tell them something, you ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) contact

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne needed help from her teacher yesterday. She wrote to ask for advice.” Bu tarif “contact” kelimesine uyar; contact = iletişim kurmak, ulaşmak. Diğer şıklar: send an e-mail (e-posta göndermek), hold (hatta beklemek, tutmak), speak to (biriyle konuşmak).

24

Kerem's phone made a sound when a call arrived yesterday. He heard it from the next room and answered. Phones normally ______ to announce a call.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) ring

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem's phone made a sound when a call arrived yesterday. He heard it from the next room and answered.” Bu tarif “ring” kelimesine uyar; ring = telefon çalmak. Diğer şıklar: communicate (iletişim kurmak), have a live chat (canlı, görüntülü sohbet etmek), hang on (hatta beklemek).

25

Buse called a company yesterday. The receptionist answered, and Buse asked for the sales manager. The receptionist transferred the call. Her job was to ______ to the manager.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) put someone through

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse called a company yesterday. The receptionist answered, and Buse asked for the sales manager. The receptionist transferred the call.” Bu tarif “put someone through” kelimesine uyar; put someone through = telefonda birine bağlamak. Diğer şıklar: call back (geri aramak), get back (arayana geri dönmek), pick up (telefonu açmak, kaldırmak).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Deniz's family wrote to relatives before they used the Internet. They put paper in envelopes and sent it by post. His grandmother still enjoys receiving a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) letter

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz's family wrote to relatives before they used the Internet. They put paper in envelopes and sent it by post.” Bu tarif “letter” kelimesine uyar; letter = mektup. Diğer şıklar: call center (çağrı merkezi), smartphone (akıllı telefon), text message (kısa mesaj).

2

İdil's grandfather described a short urgent written message from the past. A telegraph service carried it, and a printed copy reached the receiver. That message was a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) telegram

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil's grandfather described a short urgent written message from the past. A telegraph service carried it, and a printed copy reached the receiver.” Bu tarif “telegram” kelimesine uyar; telegram = telgraf. Diğer şıklar: message (mesaj), memo (kısa not, hatırlatma notu), mobile phone (cep telefonu).

3

Onur organised a telephone meeting for his group yesterday. He chose a suitable day and time and told everyone. To organise something in this way is to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) arrange

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur organised a telephone meeting for his group yesterday. He chose a suitable day and time and told everyone.” Bu tarif “arrange” kelimesine uyar; arrange = ayarlamak, düzenlemek. Diğer şıklar: pick up (telefonu açmak, kaldırmak), hang up (telefonu kapatmak), contact (iletişim kurmak, ulaşmak).

4

Zeynep called a friend yesterday. The friend was already speaking to someone else on the same line. Zeynep heard a busy tone. The line was ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) engaged

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep called a friend yesterday. The friend was already speaking to someone else on the same line. Zeynep heard a busy tone.” Bu tarif “engaged” kelimesine uyar; engaged = meşgul (telefon hattı). Diğer şıklar: polite (kibar, nazik), available (müsait, uygun), face-to-face (yüz yüze).

5

Arda answered a call for his father yesterday. He asked the caller to wait while he found his father. He said, please ______ for a moment.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) hang on

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda answered a call for his father yesterday. He asked the caller to wait while he found his father.” Bu tarif “hang on” kelimesine uyar; hang on = hatta beklemek. Diğer şıklar: make a phone call (telefon etmek), dial (numara çevirmek, tuşlamak), answer the phone (telefona cevap vermek).

6

Mina phoned the library yesterday. A staff member needed to check a book and asked her to stay on the line. Mina did not end the call. She agreed to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) hold

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina phoned the library yesterday. A staff member needed to check a book and asked her to stay on the line. Mina did not end the call.” Bu tarif “hold” kelimesine uyar; hold = hatta beklemek, tutmak. Diğer şıklar: send an e-mail (e-posta göndermek), communicate (iletişim kurmak), speak to (biriyle konuşmak).

7

Ali missed a customer's call yesterday. He returned the call when he finished his meeting. Returning a call means that you ______ to the caller.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) get back

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali missed a customer's call yesterday. He returned the call when he finished his meeting.” Bu tarif “get back” kelimesine uyar; get back = arayana geri dönmek. Diğer şıklar: have a live chat (canlı, görüntülü sohbet etmek), charge (şarj etmek), take a message (başkası için mesaj almak).

8

Pelin wanted to talk to her classmate yesterday. She used her phone to start a spoken conversation. She usually prefers talking to writing. She decided to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) make a phone call

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin wanted to talk to her classmate yesterday. She used her phone to start a spoken conversation. She usually prefers talking to writing.” Bu tarif “make a phone call” kelimesine uyar; make a phone call = telefon etmek. Diğer şıklar: write a letter (mektup yazmak), put someone through (telefonda birine bağlamak), call back (geri aramak).

9

Efe wrote a digital letter to his teacher yesterday. He added a file and used an Internet address with an at sign. He chose to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) send an e-mail

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe wrote a digital letter to his teacher yesterday. He added a file and used an Internet address with an at sign.” Bu tarif “send an e-mail” kelimesine uyar; send an e-mail = e-posta göndermek. Diğer şıklar: keep in touch (iletişimde kalmak), text (mesaj atmak, yazmak), connect (bağlamak, bağlanmak).

10

Derya talked with her cousin online yesterday. They saw each other's faces and responded immediately. They usually choose this live video method. They like to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) have a live chat

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya talked with her cousin online yesterday. They saw each other's faces and responded immediately. They usually choose this live video method.” Bu tarif “have a live chat” kelimesine uyar; have a live chat = canlı, görüntülü sohbet etmek. Diğer şıklar: repeat (tekrar etmek), ring (telefon çalmak), leave a message (mesaj bırakmak).

11

Berk needed an answer from a particular member of staff yesterday. He called the office and asked for that person's name. He wanted to ______ that person.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) speak to

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk needed an answer from a particular member of staff yesterday. He called the office and asked for that person's name.” Bu tarif “speak to” kelimesine uyar; speak to = biriyle konuşmak. Diğer şıklar: hang up (telefonu kapatmak), call back (geri aramak), put someone through (telefonda birine bağlamak).

12

Sena pressed the answer button when a call arrived yesterday. Her brother normally answers, but she was nearer the phone. She decided to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) pick up

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena pressed the answer button when a call arrived yesterday. Her brother normally answers, but she was nearer the phone.” Bu tarif “pick up” kelimesine uyar; pick up = telefonu açmak, kaldırmak. Diğer şıklar: hang on (hatta beklemek), repeat (tekrar etmek), write a letter (mektup yazmak).

13

Burak checked his phone during break yesterday. He wrote a short note and sent it without starting a voice call. He chose to ______ his friend.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) text

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak checked his phone during break yesterday. He wrote a short note and sent it without starting a voice call.” Bu tarif “text” kelimesine uyar; text = mesaj atmak, yazmak. Diğer şıklar: contact (iletişim kurmak, ulaşmak), connect (bağlamak, bağlanmak), get back (arayana geri dönmek).

14

Eda's aunt introduced a new way to contact the family yesterday. They use words and signs to exchange information. The general process of exchanging information is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) communication

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda's aunt introduced a new way to contact the family yesterday. They use words and signs to exchange information.” Bu tarif “communication” kelimesine uyar; communication = iletişim. Diğer şıklar: receiver (aranan kişi; ahize), secretary (sekreter), caller (arayan kişi).

15

Tuna's grandparents live far from him. They spoke on the phone yesterday and shared family news. People exchange information when they ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) communicate

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna's grandparents live far from him. They spoke on the phone yesterday and shared family news.” Bu tarif “communicate” kelimesine uyar; communicate = iletişim kurmak. Diğer şıklar: leave a message (mesaj bırakmak), charge (şarj etmek), arrange (ayarlamak, düzenlemek).

16

Cem tried to phone the school yesterday. A fault prevented calls from reaching it. The fault affected the school's telephone ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) line

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem tried to phone the school yesterday. A fault prevented calls from reaching it.” Bu tarif “line” kelimesine uyar; line = telefon hattı. Diğer şıklar: extension (dahili hat (numarası)), appointment (randevu), telegram (telgraf).

17

Aylin read about the first telephone for her project yesterday. People created a device that did not exist before. Such a new creation is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) invention

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin read about the first telephone for her project yesterday. People created a device that did not exist before.” Bu tarif “invention” kelimesine uyar; invention = icat, buluş. Diğer şıklar: call center (çağrı merkezi), communication (iletişim), caller (arayan kişi).

18

Eren's family has an old telephone with a part you lift to speak and listen. Eren lifted this part when it rang yesterday. This part is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) receiver

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren's family has an old telephone with a part you lift to speak and listen. Eren lifted this part when it rang yesterday.” Bu tarif “receiver” kelimesine uyar; receiver = aranan kişi; ahize. Diğer şıklar: line (telefon hattı), memo (kısa not, hatırlatma notu), message (mesaj).

19

Nehir called an office yesterday. A staff member joined her call to the right department. Telephone systems allow people to ______ calls to different departments.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) connect

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir called an office yesterday. A staff member joined her call to the right department.” Bu tarif “connect” kelimesine uyar; connect = bağlamak, bağlanmak. Diğer şıklar: hold (hatta beklemek, tutmak), keep in touch (iletişimde kalmak), answer the phone (telefona cevap vermek).

20

Baran called a shop before leaving home yesterday. He wanted to ask whether an item was in stock. He normally uses his telephone to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) make a phone call

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran called a shop before leaving home yesterday. He wanted to ask whether an item was in stock.” Bu tarif “make a phone call” kelimesine uyar; make a phone call = telefon etmek. Diğer şıklar: dial (numara çevirmek, tuşlamak), ring (telefon çalmak), hang on (hatta beklemek).

21

İpek wrote down a visitor's words for her manager yesterday. Her manager was outside, so İpek recorded the name, number and details. She needed to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) take a message

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek wrote down a visitor's words for her manager yesterday. Her manager was outside, so İpek recorded the name, number and details.” Bu tarif “take a message” kelimesine uyar; take a message = başkası için mesaj almak. Diğer şıklar: communicate (iletişim kurmak), text (mesaj atmak, yazmak), send an e-mail (e-posta göndermek).

22

Tolga put a handwritten note in an envelope yesterday. He added a stamp and took it to the post office. He chose to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) write a letter

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga put a handwritten note in an envelope yesterday. He added a stamp and took it to the post office.” Bu tarif “write a letter” kelimesine uyar; write a letter = mektup yazmak. Diğer şıklar: ring (telefon çalmak), keep in touch (iletişimde kalmak), speak to (biriyle konuşmak).

23

Eylül asked the caller to say a difficult name again yesterday. She did not hear it clearly the first time. She asked the caller to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) repeat

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül asked the caller to say a difficult name again yesterday. She did not hear it clearly the first time.” Bu tarif “repeat” kelimesine uyar; repeat = tekrar etmek. Diğer şıklar: call back (geri aramak), dial (numara çevirmek, tuşlamak), charge (şarj etmek).

24

Ozan called a classmate yesterday, but the classmate could not answer. Ozan spoke after the recorded greeting and gave his number. He decided to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) leave a message

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan called a classmate yesterday, but the classmate could not answer. Ozan spoke after the recorded greeting and gave his number.” Bu tarif “leave a message” kelimesine uyar; leave a message = mesaj bırakmak. Diğer şıklar: answer the phone (telefona cevap vermek), contact (iletişim kurmak, ulaşmak), pick up (telefonu açmak, kaldırmak).

25

Cemre spoke to her friend by phone last night. She said goodbye after they finished their conversation. Then she pressed the red end-call button. She chose to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) hang up

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre spoke to her friend by phone last night. She said goodbye after they finished their conversation. Then she pressed the red end-call button.” Bu tarif “hang up” kelimesine uyar; hang up = telefonu kapatmak. Diğer şıklar: have a live chat (canlı, görüntülü sohbet etmek), take a message (başkası için mesaj almak), hold (hatta beklemek, tutmak).
